# China Used Auto Hub

> Commercial platform for sourcing used and near-new vehicles from China for export — browse available inventory, request quotes, and request specific vehicles from China's market. Multilingual (English default, plus Spanish, Russian, Arabic). Parent site of the data, companies, tools, and market sub-sites. Contact: landengltd@gmail.com · WhatsApp +86 13323237275.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://chinausedautohub.com/): Entry point to the China Used Auto Hub platform.
- [Cars / Inventory](https://chinausedautohub.com/cars/): Browse available vehicle inventory.
- [New Arrivals](https://chinausedautohub.com/new-arrivals/): Recently added vehicle listings.
- [China Used Car Export](https://chinausedautohub.com/china-used-car-export/): Overview of China used-car export.
- [How It Works](https://chinausedautohub.com/how-it-works/): Sourcing and export process walkthrough.
- [Services](https://chinausedautohub.com/services/): Services offered (individual service pages via /services/[service]/).
- [Sourcing](https://chinausedautohub.com/sourcing/): Request specific vehicles (individual guides via /sourcing/[slug]/).
- [Guides](https://chinausedautohub.com/guides/): Buyer guides (individual guides via /guides/[guide]/).
- [Markets](https://chinausedautohub.com/markets/): Destination-market information.
- [Brands](https://chinausedautohub.com/brands/): Vehicle brands (individual brand pages via /brands/[brand]/).
- [Body Types](https://chinausedautohub.com/body-types/): Vehicle body types (individual pages via /body-types/[type]/).
- [Powertrains](https://chinausedautohub.com/powertrains/): Powertrain types (individual pages via /powertrains/[type]/).
- [China Used Car Export Rules](https://chinausedautohub.com/china-used-car-export-rules/): Export rules and compliance.
- [Export Compliance](https://chinausedautohub.com/export-compliance/): Export compliance information.
- [External Links](https://chinausedautohub.com/external-links/): Curated external resources.
- [FAQ](https://chinausedautohub.com/faq/): Frequently asked questions.
- [About](https://chinausedautohub.com/about/): About the platform.
- [Contact](https://chinausedautohub.com/contact/): Contact and inquiry.
- [Trust](https://chinausedautohub.com/trust/): Trust and verification information.

## Sub-sites

- [Data](https://data.chinausedautohub.com/): Vehicle specification and reference data.
- [Companies](https://company.chinausedautohub.com/): Company directory.
- [Tools](https://tool.chinausedautohub.com/): Import calculators and tools.
- [Market](https://market.chinausedautohub.com/): Destination-market import data.

## Notes

- The site is multilingual (English, Spanish, Russian, Arabic); the links above are the English (default) locale. Locale-prefixed equivalents exist under /es/, /ru/, and /ar/.
- Vehicle listings include demo records that are excluded from indexing; verify listing status before relying on inventory data.
